# IREA 2017 Sun Park / LPB legal-matter cross-link decision

**Control date:** 28 August 2026  
**Decision:** authorised, minimized, purpose-specific public cross-link  
**Authority:** current authenticated instruction to scan historical emails and media, capture evidence, add the result to the page and interlink IREA/Colliers, RICPE and the proposed witness

## Bounded proposition admitted to the legal-matter record

Authenticated September 2017 correspondence directly connects Aweswell/LPB's Sun Park refinancing effort with IREA Corporate Finance: executed confidentiality, receipt and review of detailed Sun Park/LPB material, meetings with the Hotels team, coordination with Cuatrecasas and a defined proposed debt-raising advisory scope.

This cross-link is admitted because it concerns the same hotel, the LPB insolvency/refinancing route, the Cerberus/Promontoria-secured debt and the same professional-adviser continuity already relevant to Project Meridian. Publication is limited to a proposition-level derivative.

## Prohibited publication

Private message identifiers, addresses, subjects, body text, attachments, account identifiers and provider locators remain outside Git and the website. No private-source material may be repurposed for transaction development from this public derivative.

## Limits

The cross-link does not establish a final executed IREA mandate, lender outreach, completed financing, current Colliers custody, family relationship, information transfer, conflict, wrongdoing or liability. Those propositions require separate primary evidence and actor-specific proof.
